_purpose: Phase 5B. Frozen protocol for comparing RQMC/MC sampling-schedule policies under wall-clock budgets. The policies are defined from a cost model and one prior constant (alpha) before any Phase-5B run; none of their constants is tuned on these scenarios. Committed before the study is run.

prior_constants.alpha_source: Phase-4 fixed-N study (results/phase4_greek_aware/study/H2_slopes_summary.csv): PCA-RQMC RMSE slope about -1 in N for m = 12, 52, 104, i.e. variance ~ N^-2. Development data, disjoint from this grid.
prior_constants.r_min_reason: t_{7,0.975} = 2.36; chosen a priori as the smallest replicate count we are willing to base a t-interval on for the 'mse' objective

cost_model.form: RQMC: c0 + R (a + b N); MC: c0' + K (u + c n_b)
cost_model.fit: budget_policy.calibrate_cost_model: non-negative least squares on relative errors, medians of 7 repeats, R in {2,4,8}, N in {16,64,256,1024,4096}; one model per (m, Greek, randomisation), measured at the start of the run
cost_model.phase4_model: asian_qmc.calibrate_rqmc(pooled=True) is also measured, for the baseline scheduler only

strategies.MC-base: Phase-3/4 MC: asian_qmc.timed_estimate, at least 4 blocks, stop after the budget is spent
strategies.PCA-base: Phase-3/4 RQMC: largest power-of-two N with 10 scramblings fitting (N >= 16), at least 4 scramblings, stop after the budget is spent
strategies.PCA-fixed64: fixed N = 64, R from the cost model, feasible iff R >= r_min; look-ahead stopping
strategies.PCA-opt-ci: optimise_schedule(objective='ci'): minimise t^2_{R-1} N^-alpha / R, R >= 3, Owen scrambling
strategies.PCA-shift-mse: as PCA-opt-mse with random digital shifts of a cached Sobol' set (point-set generation amortised)
strategies.PCA-shift-ci: as PCA-opt-ci with random digital shifts

composite_policies.phase4: PCA-base if B >= 10 (a_m + 64 b_m) with the Phase-4 pooled model, else MC-base (the Phase-4 pipeline unchanged)
composite_policies.feasible-owen: PCA-opt-mse if B >= 10 (a + 64 b) with the new Owen cost model and the plan is feasible, else MC-look, else infeasible
composite_policies.feasible-shift: PCA-shift-mse if B >= 10 (a_s + 64 b_s) with the shift cost model and the plan is feasible, else MC-look, else infeasible. The rule constants 10 and 64 are reused with a different randomisation; this variant of the rule has NOT been validated and is exploratory.

grid.note: 12 scenarios; none of these K/S0, sigma, T, r values occur in Phases 2-4 or in configs/phase5_frontier.json

metrics.overrun: measured wall / budget, all work inside the call including planning; per (m, budget, strategy): median, p95, max, share > 1.10
metrics.deadline_miss: share of runs with wall > 1.10 * budget
metrics.mse: over replications against the reference, minus ref_se^2
metrics.coverage: share of replications whose 95% interval contains the reference
metrics.cost_prediction: measured wall / predicted cost of the executed plan

hypotheses.S1: Look-ahead strategies never plan infeasible work, and in every (m, budget) cell at most 5% of their runs exceed 1.10 * budget. The baseline RQMC scheduler violates this at small budgets.
hypotheses.S2: Pooled 95% interval coverage is at least 0.93 for the r_min = 8 strategies. Coverage of the 'ci' objective (R as low as 3) is reported without a threshold.
hypotheses.S3: PCA-opt-mse has time-normalised MSE no worse than PCA-base (geometric-mean ratio <= 1) in cells where both ran. Two-sided 95% bootstrap interval reported.
hypotheses.S4: Digital shifts make RQMC feasible at smaller budgets than Owen scrambling; whether they are more accurate per unit time is an open question, reported two-sided.
hypotheses.S5: Along the fine budget sweep, the largest increase of MSE between adjacent budgets (the 'cliff') is smaller for PCA-opt-mse than for PCA-base.

selection_for_later_phases: Phases 5C and 5D will use one scheduling policy chosen from these results. Because that choice is made on this grid, Phases 5C/5D use different scenarios.
